narrative.recommendations_md: The following 10 recommendations are structured around a central thesis: First United Bank has already invested in the right platforms (Salesforce, nCino, MuleSoft, Jack Henry). The path to maturity improvement requires consolidating to a single system integrator, rationalizing competing tools, and deepening utilization of already-owned capabilities. No recommendation proposes deploying a platform that First United Bank does not already own or license.
